summary: Stores script or command text that can be triggered by motion clips played through Clip CHOP and Clip Blender CHOP workflows.

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open editor to add, edit, or delete DAT text

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Text file path to load from disk or web

key_params.name: reload
key_params.note: Reload the configured text file into the DAT

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose where the Clip DAT script executes from

key_params.name: component
key_params.note: Component context used when Execute From is set to Specified Component

key_params.name: clip
key_params.note: Clip CHOP that triggers the script when played in Clip Blender CHOP

key_params.name: framefirst
key_params.note: Execute once the first time the specified clip frame is played

key_params.name: frameloop
key_params.note: Execute each time the specified clip frame is played during looping playback

key_params.name: exit
key_params.note: Execute when Clip Blender exits the specified clip

key_params.name: printstate
key_params.note: Print debug state information to the textport

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: External editor extension exposed by the DAT

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Clip DAT is Pro-only; generated networks need a license guard or fallback path.
Scripts trigger through Clip Blender CHOP playback, not merely by editing text in the DAT.
Execute-on-loop can run repeatedly for looping clips, so callbacks should avoid one-shot side effects unless guarded.
Clip DAT differs from Text DAT because it has Execute behavior tied to clip playback.
key_concepts: Stores script or command text used by motion clips and Clip CHOP/Clip Blender CHOP workflows.
Adds Execute-page callbacks for first frame, loop frame, and exit events.
Can bind the clip script to a specific clip and component context.
Clip DAT is Pro-only according to the official operator page.
platform_notes: Official operator page marks Clip DAT as available only in TouchDesigner Pro.
